concept: Breath and voice as the instrument: contagion, deep space, quarantine, the gasp for air.

tracks.title: Vox Clausa
tracks.final: Visceral, rhythmic breathing and low-end drones claw out of claustrophobic silence, then tighten into stuttering risers and synthetic hits until the panic goes full sci-fi. Built as a strict three-act suffocation — isolated panting up front, dread in the middle, terror at the back. Cut it into the moment the air turns against the characters.

new.description: A sharp vocal gasp ignites a ticking synthetic pulse, fracturing into aggressive brass blasts and heavy impacts before a choral climax strikes — a suffocation sequence rendered in sound. Structured for hard trailer cutting with clear dialogue pockets, dropping into a stark breakdown at 1:22 before the final push and a sudden 2:34 title-card gap that rings out on a lone voice. Drop it where the contagion breaches the perimeter. Fits: viral outbreaks, desperate final stands, sci-fi horror.
new.editor_note: A sudden 2:34 title-card gap drops to pure silence before the final mournful vocal rings out.

old.description: For the moment a terrifying truth is revealed: a solo female voice sings a falling melody over a low drone. A sharp breath at 0:31 starts a ticking pulse, forcing a heavy brass impact at 1:06 before the melody transfers to a full choir at 2:14. The 1:22 breakdown clears space for dialogue, and an abrupt stop at 2:34 leaves a clean title-card gap. Fits: Trailer, TV Promo, Film.
old.editor_note: The 1:22 breakdown provides clear dialogue room, and the 2:34 drop to silence leaves a clean title-card gap.

tracks.title: Last Light, No Air
tracks.final: Suffocating, anxious breaths and vocal foley drift beneath massive overdriven synth swells, metallic groans and abyssal impacts — terrifying scale and crushing pressure, the human sound tiny against the void. Modular and structure-driven, built on vast negative space and isolated hits. For absolute isolation and impending destruction.

new.description: Rhythmic human panting and a low drone lock into a ticking pulse, accelerating into a distorted bass groove before snapping back to isolated gasps. Strings and brass escalate the panic into a heavy climax — the breath itself becomes the countdown. Mapped in waves, featuring a stark breakdown at 1:32 that clears the deck for dialogue before the final assault rings out. Cut it into the desperate sprint for survival. Fits: oxygen deprivation, contagion thrillers, desperate escapes.
new.editor_note: The dead-stop breakdown at 1:32 isolates the breathing, creating an instant pocket for critical dialogue.

tracks.title: Hypoxia
tracks.final: Desperate, fading breath foley and crushing atmospheric pressure tip into a heavy, disorienting climax — oxygen deprivation and fading consciousness rendered as sound, organic choking fused with synthetic weight. Disorienting pacing built to simulate the body shutting down.

new.description: Rhythmic human breath and a dark sub drone set a primal pace, accelerating into a metallic synth ostinato before detonating into aggressive brass and heavy impacts — a suffocating panic attack rendered in sound. Maps a strict escalation from isolated gasps to total climax, snapping to a hard cut at 2:54 that leaves only the breath ringing out. Drop it where the air runs out and the chase begins. Fits: deep-space survival, contagion thrillers, adrenaline escapes.
new.editor_note: The hard cut at 2:54 exposes isolated breathing for an instant title card drop.

tracks.title: Proximal
tracks.final: An eerie, close-mic'd breath loop and unsettling synthetic textures hold you at unbearable proximity, then sharpen into a jagged climax — the threat is right here, inescapable, breathing on your neck. Patient and modular, built for sustained tension that finally snaps.

new.description: A metallic ticking pulse tracks the contagion under a high synth drone, dropping into an aggressive electronic groove and distorted bass before chaotic trailer impacts fracture the rhythm — a quarantine systems failure. Built around a hard breakdown at 1:24 that clears the beat for ticking tension, returning with driving strings before a final impact rings out. Cut it into the moment the facility locks down. Fits: quarantine breaches, sci-fi action, countdown tension.
new.editor_note: The dead-stop breakdown at 1:24 hands you a clean reset before the final chaotic string escalation.

old.description: For the reveal of a mechanical threat: a high synth sits over clear air until a metallic ticking establishes a rhythm at 0:11. The beat returns with a fast string ostinato at 1:35, escalating into chaotic stutters before cutting hard to a final impact at 2:44. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo

tracks.title: Delicate Matter
tracks.final: Eerie, disembodied vocal textures and fragile low swells stretch anticipation toward collapse, with labored breath surfacing underneath — crushing, patient dread that promises something terrible. A sustained Act-1/Act-2 build for the long sequences where doom keeps approaching.

new.description: A breathy vocal gasp ticks over a low drone until synthetic brass and heavy impacts crush the space, accelerating into frantic strings — the human element swallowed by mechanical failure. Escalates from a dialogue-clear opening to a hard drop at 1:08. The rhythm breaks for a rising texture at 2:24, detonating into a chaotic climax that cuts dead at 2:47 for a final vocal button. Drop it where the quarantine fails. Fits: contagion thrillers, escalating disaster, final reveals.
new.editor_note: The hard cut at 2:47 leaves a clean reverb tail before the final vocal button at 2:57.

tracks.title: Containment Collapse
tracks.final: Struggling gasps and warning klaxons give way to explosive decompression and grinding metallic distortion — a catastrophic systems failure rendered in sound. Hard-grid disaster cue that escalates from quiet alarm to total breach. For the instant the seal fails and the air rushes out.

new.description:

The timeline escalates from stark isolation to a dense electronic climax, providing a hard cut to dead silence at 2:38 before a final fade. Drop it where the deep space seal breaches and the oxygen vents.

Fits: deep-space disaster, quarantine breach, sci-fi horror
new.editor_note: The sudden drop to dead silence at 2:38 creates a stark vacuum for a title card.

tracks.title: Cryovoid
tracks.final: Dry, erratic hyperventilation and a distorted pulse build unbearable suspense, weaponizing stark drop-outs and hard vacuum cuts — sound, then sudden nothing. Advanced modular tension that simulates complete panic and oxygen deprivation. For the silence that's scarier than the noise.

new.description: An airy synth texture acts as the gasp for air, suffocating while a rhythmic pulse and distorted brass crush the space, before a drop at 2:13 accelerates into an aggressive back-end — a mechanical suffocation you can feel. Mapped for modular cutting, the frantic rhythm snaps to a ringing decay at 2:22. Cut it where the quarantine seal fails and the contagion takes over. Fits: deep space quarantine, contagion outbreaks, frantic escapes.
new.editor_note: A hard drop at 2:13 launches a frantic back-end rhythm that snaps to a ringing decay at 2:22.

tracks.title: Tremor
tracks.final: Sparse subterranean rumbles and metallic ticks accelerate from unsettling quiet into something hyper-kinetic and aggressively distorted — instability building to collapse. A dynamic structure that ramps from negative space to overwhelming density, simulating structural failure and rising panic.

new.description: A dark drone and metallic impacts establish a deep-space quarantine, before a ticking pulse and distorted brass trigger a heavy rhythm — a mechanical contagion that slowly chokes out the room. Patient dialogue room shatters at 0:54 when the clock starts, driving a strict escalation that terminates on a hard final hit and a ten-second ring-out. Drop it where the airlock seals and the panic sets in. Fits: deep-space dread, contagion outbreak, frantic escape.
new.editor_note: Clear dialogue space until 0:54, when a ticking pulse kicks off a heavy three-act escalation.

Clear air carries dialogue to 0:54; the 1:44 drop offers a hard cut-in, and the 2:23 hit leaves a title-card gap. Fits: Trailer, Teaser, TV Promo

tracks.title: Feral
tracks.final: Primal, hyper-aggressive foley and chaotic synth overdrive lock into a fight-or-flight pulse and never let go — dense, high-tempo, no negative space, pure adrenaline. The breath here isn't fear, it's the animal taking over. Built for the chase that doesn't stop.

new.description: Ticking percussion and a sub-drone establish a dark bed before staccato strings accelerate the pulse. A drop-out clears the floor, then heavy impacts and brass stabs push toward a climax where full choir takes over — the voice here isn't human, it's the contagion itself. Built around a title card gap at 0:58, escalating into a dense back end that buttons on a hard impact and rings out. Drop it where the quarantine fails. Fits: quarantine breaches, contagion reveals.
new.editor_note: A dead-stop title card gap at 0:58 provides a clear pivot before the heavy brass and choir hit.

old.description: For the beat a high-stakes threat is revealed: a sub drone and ticking percussion establish a dark bed at 0:00. Staccato strings introduce a rising figure at 0:28, which drops to a sub boom at 0:58 before heavy percussion and brass stabs answer at 1:05. A full choir joins the climax at 1:56 until a final drum hit releases the sequence at 2:36. Fits: Trailer, TV Promo, Film

tracks.title: Sacrilege
tracks.final: The breath concept at its most monumental — a cyclic, distorted breath loop and corrupted vocalizations swell over an oppressive drone until the whole thing detonates into colossal industrial sound design. A slow oppression that pays off in a wall-of-sound back end, built for the final beat of a dark sci-fi or horror campaign. Drop it where the threat stops hiding.

new.description: Low drones and metallic textures establish a static bed before processed breathing locks into a steady pulse beneath a descending motif. The rhythm holds the space until a synth-brass blast shatters the isolation, accelerating into ticking percussion and driving ostinati — the gasp for air weaponized into total panic. Patient structure mapped for clear dialogue before the hard impact at 0:48 forces a sharp reset. The back half escalates through ticking percussion into an aggressive climax of driving synths, offering multiple cut points before ending on a final hit that rings out. Cut it into the moment a hidden contagion breaks containment and the escape begins. Fits: contagion outbreaks, frantic escapes, sci-fi horror.
new.editor_note: The hard impact at 0:48 provides a clean reset for a title card or act break.

tracks.title: Unleashed
tracks.final: Raw, panicked hyperventilation and chaotic, hyper-kinetic sound design hit at maximum intensity — tension built not from anticipation but from sheer frantic breath, a fight-or-flight response under crushing pressure. Dense and high-BPM, chaotic impact over slow build. For the panic that explodes instead of creeping.

new.description: A low sub drone and sparse metallic textures hold a deep space quarantine, until rhythmic ticking accelerates and blaring synth brass and a violent electronic beat shatter the hull — the contagion here is a total mechanical breach. Patient front-end isolation preserves dialogue room before the 1:04 pulse initiates a countdown, escalating to a hard drop at 2:00 and an abrupt cut at 2:45 that rings out. Drop it where the threat finally shows itself. Fits: deep-space dread, contagion outbreaks, sudden ambushes.
new.editor_note: Clear dialogue room for the first minute before the 1:04 pulse drives toward the 2:00 beat drop.

tracks.title: Splintered Nerve
tracks.final: The breath fractures into sharp, involuntary gasps amid grinding industrial sound design — jagged, hyper-tense, a nervous system overloading. Modular tension that lurches from sparse gasping foley into technological breakdown. For neurological dread and systems coming apart.

new.description: A ticking pulse and falling piano measure out the dwindling oxygen of a dead quarantine, then shatter into heavy impacts and distorted brass — a mechanical contagion overtaking the system. Three-act escalation built around a hard drop at 1:28, offering a clean breakdown at 2:04 before surging to a climax that rings out on a lone piano note. Cut it into the exact moment the airlock fails. Fits: deep-space disaster, quarantine breach, sci-fi action.
new.editor_note: Hard drop at 1:28 shifts the track from ticking suspense to heavy trailer action.
